title: T-70 (bundle 20261114-110317, mod 0.3.3: 'if you rent scooter your friend can't use it'). TEST of the fix (rig run T-SCOOTER-20261115-021236 measured the copy at kinematic 2/2 and 0.00 m under full throttle): the host rents an e-scooter the game's way and parks it (its kinematic count is captured); the merged friend's copy is frozen while parked, gets on, the copy's main body is non-kinematic and full throttle for 5 s moves it at least 1 m; the friend gets off, the copy is frozen again (N/N) and the host's own scooter reads the same kinematic count as before the borrow. Kept: the owner's click while the friend rides (toast reported) and the reverse 'owner-using' refusal. Ends dissolved; NO save.
